source: EN 303-5:2012 'Heating boilers for solid fuels'; IEA Bioenergy Task 32 'Combustion of solid biomass'; Carvalho et al. (2013), Energy 58, 290-301.

Q_rated.notes: 50 kW small commercial wood pellet boiler

eta_nom.notes: 0.85-0.92 typical for modern automatic pellet boilers (EN 303-5 class 5)

a0.description: Constant term in part-load efficiency polynomial
a0.notes: a0+a1+a2 must equal 1.0; convex curve with eta drop at low PLR

a1.notes: Tuned to match EN 303-5 part-load measurements

a2.notes: Negative -> efficiency rolls off at very high PLR (excess air losses)

PLR_min.notes: Below ~0.30 PLR, biomass boilers cycle on/off and emissions rise

LHV_fuel_MJ_kg.description: Lower heating value of biomass fuel (dry basis)
LHV_fuel_MJ_kg.notes: Wood pellets ~17-18 MJ/kg; wood chips ~16-19 MJ/kg dry

moisture_content.description: Fuel moisture content (mass fraction, wet basis)

co2_factor_g_per_kwh_th.description: Operational/upstream CO2 factor for biomass (excludes biogenic)
co2_factor_g_per_kwh_th.notes: Carbon-neutral biogenic CO2 excluded; processing+transport residuals
